commitments.detail: The dual-credit environmental science course will be approved.
Ms. Patel will confirm her availability and qualifications.
The Registrar will manage student enrollments within the maximum of 28 students.
Ensure all enrolled students receive the necessary materials and support for the dual-credit environmental science course.
Accurately record student enrollments and academic performance for both high school and community college transcripts.
Provide necessary course materials and ensure student engagement.
Maintain a maximum of 28 students per class.
